::: {#exm-racket-height}
#### Size and height in Racket

The recursive formulas of @rem-size-height become

```racket
(define (size T)
  (if (empty? T)
      0
      (+ 1 (size (second T)) (size (third T)))))

(define (height T)
  (if (empty? T)
      -1
      (+ 1 (max (height (second T)) (height (third T))))))
```

Here `(max a b)` returns the larger of the numbers `a` and `b`.

With `B` as in @exr-racket-tree, `(size B)` returns 9 and `(height B)` returns 3,
and `(height '())` returns -1.

:::
